hook_text: NSAM 177 assigned AID operating and funding responsibility for foreign police programs while excluding covert aspects.
Kennedy treated police assistance as part of the response to Communist indirect aggression in NSAM 132.
NSAM 162 discussed police, paramilitary and military resources in a wider internal-defense frame.
A July 1962 interagency committee recommended an AID-led structure with roles retained by State and Defense.
